findings.source_quote: With many a mystery light somewhere up there?
findings.suggested_fix: Translate more idiomatically and grammatically: replace "Med många ljus som något mysterium där?" with e.g. "Med många mystiska ljus där uppe?" to convey the sense and read naturally in Swedish.

findings.source_quote: In the still silence of the spacious sky,
findings.suggested_fix: Fix grammatical agreement and idiomatic phrasing: replace "I den stilla tystnad i det vida sky" with e.g. "I den stilla tystnaden i den vida himlen" or "I den stilla tystnaden i det vida skyn".
findings.translation_quote: I den stilla tystnad i det vida sky

findings.location: <div class="poem"> lines about the moon, third stanza
findings.source_quote:
And yet it took man three whole days to reach
That tiny sphere so very close at hand.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct grammatical gender/word form: replace "den lilla klotet" with "det lilla klotet" (or use "det lilla klotet"/"det lilla himlakroppen") so the noun and article agree.
findings.translation_quote: Att nå den lilla klotet så nära till hands.
